geometryHashEncoding: SHA256 of JSON sorted keys, compact separators, UTF8 and trailing LF
limitations: Display line LOD only; it does not change or claim exact fine polygon fill boundaries.
300m DP budget excludes later vector-tile quantization and pitched-view perspective; delivery verifier must audit those separately.
Exact lines remain available at zoom>=7; new normal-mode auxiliary lines must not replace operational fronts or national/coast geometry.

policy.continuousDeviationBasis: For each retained chord, every original subchain vertex is within the finite-segment distance bound. Identical endpoints, convexity along each original segment and continuous longitudinal projection bound both continuous polyline directions. IEEE-double measured values are independently rechecked; no gameplay numeric tolerance changes.
policy.retainedNativeCoordinates: exact ordered original vertex subsequence; never inverse-projected
policy.topologyGuard: Exact normalized intersection geometry of every selected-selected and selected-protected country/coast pair is identical to baseline in both CRS84 and EPSG3857. Related simplified arcs revert in full until stable.

sourceBasis.method: Only existing accepted 994 province presentation arcs are simplified; sources are not reselected.
sourceBasis.temporalLimitation: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. It is used as an experimental county geometry reference for the 2020-01-01 game scenario, not certified 2020 or untouched 2017 administrative truth. No unverified change is backdated.
